verdict.rationale: Microsoft's FAQ states directly that Authenticator codes do not need internet or data, so offline TOTP generation is first-party documented. The no-vendor-account half is not stated anywhere. The docs show the app works with non-Microsoft accounts, and a Microsoft personal account appears only for the optional cloud backup, which implies but does not confirm that no account is needed just to view codes. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no Microsoft account or sign-in is needed to view TOTP codes, independent or hands-on confirmation of fully offline code generation.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: The codes don't require you to be on the internet or connected to data, so you don't need phone service to sign in.
non-Microsoft accounts, such as Amazon, Facebook, Instagram and Google
